mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.5% for two consecutive months, it signals an extreme monetary easing policy that boosts equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC over 2-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a sharp contraction in consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.5%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals worsening labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In UNRATE > 6.5% periods with PAYEMS decline, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC over 2-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past three months indicates robust supply chain activity and corporate capacity utilization, supporting higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with rising INDPRO, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC over 2-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1600 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a strong housing market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate revenues, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate severe labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases and PAYEMS declines in the past month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.
